recentItems.title: Girl who lost 17 family members speaks to CNN
recentItems.description: As the death toll exceeds 1,000 in Nepal, many are still searching and grieving for their loved ones. CNN’s Will Ripley reports. #cnn #news #nepal

recentItems.title: Nepal’s search for their missing loved ones
recentItems.description: In the devastating aftermath of the flash flood in Nepal, police probe the grass and scour the riverbanks for bodies swept downstream from the Himalayas. CNN's Hanako Montgomery goes on a search and recovery mission with the Nepali police in Bharatpur.

recentItems.title: CNN joins a search & recovery mission with Nepali police
recentItems.description:
CNN’s Hanako Montgomery goes on the ground with Nepali police as they lead a difficult search and recovery mission for bodies washed down from the mountains. Plus, CNN’s Anderson Cooper speaks with Nepal’s foreign minister about the desperate race to rescue hundreds of trapped workers and why the nation is demanding global climate justice for a crisis it didn't cause.

recentItems.title: House votes to censure Rep. Chuck Edwards
recentItems.description: The House on Tuesday took the rare step of punishing one of its members — GOP Rep. Chuck Edwards — over allegations of inappropriate behavior toward two female staffers. The congressman apologized for putting the staffers in uncomfortable positions but fiercely denied ever sexually harassing them.

recentItems.title: What happens next with Trump’s ballroom?
recentItems.description: The Supreme Court handed President Trump a huge win on his new White House East Wing and ballroom, and images of the site show construction is moving ahead quickly. CNN’s Betsy Klein reports.

recentItems.title: The fake NFL player who prosecutors say made more than $1 million in scam
recentItems.description: In an elaborate scheme, federal prosecutors say 35-year-old Daejon Labrayae Love scammed women by pretending to be an NFL player for the 49ers. Love and his alleged co-conspirator, 18-year-old Taylor Jamie Chan, have been charged with wire fraud and conspiracy to commit wire fraud, according to investigators. Love appeared in court in Boise, Idaho, on August 27, and is being transferred to Oregon for further hearings. Chan has elected to have a preliminary hearing in Oregon.
